title: Fix Staging Pathspec Failure
description: Staging all unstaged files fails with `error: daemon terminated` and `fatal: pathspec '(literal)…/benchmark.go' did not match any files`. Fix the failure and stage every unstaged change. Do not discard any valuable worktree or index changes.
summary: The fsmonitor socket was stale, so git printed daemon terminated and a collapsed pathspec for the metrics Go benchmark file failed the whole stage. The monitor is watching again, and every unstaged path that still exists was staged without dropping index-only blobs.
